segments.title: conclusions and recognition
segments.note: Codex Tibetan-first PROVISIONAL machine alignment; not human-approved. nges shes and drongs pa separately own definite conclusion and reach, both positive HGM glossary equivalents. chod pa owns analyze, positively attested in HGM; sgro 'dogs is omitted because its nominal contribution is recast in the analysis idiom, not separately identifiable as object. Its HGM gloss implying is not used: both English implying occurrences belong to the two thal consequence frames. The supplied an object and about something stay unwrapped. The two de dag occurrences own these; the first 'gro ba owns the first beings, and later beings is an English antecedent expansion. gcig ... gcig owns one ... another; phan tshun is distributed through that reciprocal construction and is omitted, not nulled. First 'dod pa'i phyir lacks a separately identified English reason frame and is omitted. Last 'dod pa owns position and phyir given. 'dod na owns the complete conditional if so. Full source wording is preserved.
